in_marathi.name: Driti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Firm, unyielding, truth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Driti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Driti is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhriti', which means firm, unyielding, truth. In Hindu mythology, Driti is the goddess of firmness, stability and unwavering determination. She is often depicted as the consort of the god Dharma, the embodiment of righteousness and moral principles.
